Mint

Claim your skill badge

Complete the form below to mint a compressed NFT to your wallet. The transaction is submitted by TalentTag; you do not pay gas at claim time on this deployment.

Before you start

  • Connect a Solana wallet or paste your address carefully.
  • Email is optional — we only use it for operational notices about your mint.
  • Double-check your wallet string; NFTs sent to the wrong address cannot be recovered by us.

What happens next

  1. 1

    Choose a skill and enter your details.

  2. 2

    We validate your wallet, then mint the cNFT.

  3. 3

    You land on your shareable proof page.

After you mint

Three simple ways to use and show your new credential.

Check your wallet

Open your NFT gallery in the wallet app you used. The badge may take a moment to appear after confirmation.

Use your proof page

Find the badge in the public gallery and open its detail page to copy a shareable link for résumés or profiles.

Verify on-chain

Use the Solscan link after minting, or paste the asset id in an explorer, so anyone can audit the record.

Explore issued badges

Browse the gallery or open a proof page from any listing.
